functions.name: Finalize
functions.docs:
Converts the raw serialized object data into the ShaderObjectData FSharedBuffer.
Note that this is called by BuildCacheRecord as well, calls subsequent to the first will have no effect.

functions.name: SerializeCode
functions.docs: Optional function which must be implemented if EnableCustomCodeSerialize returns true; use to serialize shader code separately from the main object

functions.name: ReserveCode
functions.docs: Optional function that can be used to reserve space for the given number of code objects by derived classes.

functions.name: BuildCacheRecord
functions.docs:
Helper function to generate a DDC record from the data serialized using this context. Serialization must
be executed prior to calling this function.

functions.name: Reset
functions.docs: Call to reset internal state, this allows re-using internal allocations to store other objects (as an optimization).

functions.name: Reset
functions.signature: Reset(Target, Shader Object Data, Code Buffers, Symbol Buffers)
functions.docs: Resets internal state to point to the given buffers and recreates the owned memoryreader

functions.name: Reuse
functions.docs: Call to reset reader to start position so the same load context can be used to populate multiple objects.

functions.name: ReadFromRecord
functions.docs: Helper function to populate the internal state (FSharedBuffers defined on FShaderCacheSerializeContext) from a DDC record.
